column1: # Path glob -> work package (BUILD-PLAN §2). Read by tools/owners-check.
# First matching row wins, so specific rows sit above broader ones.
# Globs: * = any characters except /, ** = any characters, {a,b} = either.
# GEN paths (written only by tools/build, tools/assemble, tools/fixtures-gen,
# tools/canary-baseline, tools/helper-replies-gen) belong to build: the
# integrator commits them on main, never a WP branch.
